title: feat(spec): declare declaredRuleNamed on ISharingRuleService; document sharing-rule regime C
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6zwDuV2XvoDkqC7bXgqnpc)_

Fixes #25187

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

This PR handles the three regime C follow-ups the card lists: the contract member, the docs paragraph and the ledger docblock. It changes no behaviour.

## What changed

1. **Contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`). `ISharingRuleService` gains an optional `declaredRuleNamed?(name: string)` member. It resolves to `{ name: string; packageId?: string }` or `null`. It is optional, has the shape the activation door already duck-typed, and its docblock covers the probe-and-refuse duty and the 503.
2. **The door reads the contract's type** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`). The local `interface DeclaredSharingRuleReader` is now a type alias: `Required` applied to a `Pick` of `ISharingRuleService`'s `declaredRuleNamed`. The change is type-only: the `typeof … === 'function'` probe, the 404 and the 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` stay as they were. A runtime build shows the symbol in no emitted file (see Evidence).
3. **`SharingRuleService` satisfies the member as declared.** It already `implements ISharingRuleService`, and its `declaredRuleNamed(name)`, which resolves to a `DeclaredSharingRule` or `null`, type-checks against the new member. Nothing in `plugin-sharing` changed.
4. **Docs** (`content/docs/permissions/sharing-rules.mdx`). This adds a new section, "Declared rules are read-only: clone one, then switch it off". It covers read-only declared rules, clone and switch off through `POST {basePath}/security/_activation/sharing_rule/:name`, the 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` refusal of a new or renamed row under a declared name, the `manage_metadata` gate plus the platform-operator wall, and the reconcile-failure window. Each claim cites the function and file it was read from at this head. The `/meta` half links to `concepts/metadata-lifecycle`, which this PR leaves unchanged and which stays consistent with the new section.
5. **Ledger docblock** (`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts`). The `metadata_type` description now lists every type the ledger holds at this head: `flow` (service-automation's flow store), `action` (objectql's action store), and `position`, `permission`, `sharing_rule` and `webhook` (the catalog activation door).
6. **Changeset** `.changeset/25187-declared-rule-reader-contract.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` at `patch`, following `Metadata-protocol: none`. `@objectstack/runtime` is not listed because its change is type-only and nothing in its published `dist` moves (see Evidence).

## How the docs claims were checked against the code

- **Read-only.** `SharingRuleService.deleteRule` refuses a declared name with `PERMISSION_DENIED`, and `sharing-routes.ts` `handleError` answers 403. `PUT /meta/sharing_rule/:name` is refused because the `sharing_rule` registry row in `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` sets `allowRuntimeCreate: false`.
- **409.** `DeclaredSharingRuleNameConflictError` sets `code = 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` and `status = 409`. It is thrown by `defineRule` (create) and by `bindDeclaredRuleNameGuard`'s `beforeInsert`/`beforeUpdate` hooks (insert, and a rename onto a declared name). System writes are exempt.
- **Operator wall.** In `activation-gate.ts`, `refuseUngrantedActivationAuthoring` requires `manage_metadata`. `refuseUngrantedActivationWrite` is inert when no posture is set, or under `single`; under a wall it requires `posture === 'PLATFORM_ADMIN'`. `SHARING_RULE_ACTIVATION_SUBJECT.remedy` names the platform operator.
- **Reconcile window.** `bindSharingRuleActivationReconcile` registers a plain `registerHook` handler with no `meta`, so `ObjectQL.opensAfterAbortUnit` opens no unit. `ObjectStoreMetadataActivationStore.setActive` opens no transaction. So the ledger row stays written when the reconcile throws, and the door answers the error through `errorFromThrown(err, 503)`. At boot, `kernel:bootstrapped` in `sharing-plugin.ts` runs the `listRules` backfill, which includes served declared projections, and then `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants`, which revokes the grants of a declared rule that is no longer served. A repeated switch re-runs the reconcile because `setActive` always issues an `update`, and `afterUpdate` fires on it.

## Evidence

All readings were taken on head `672daf099`, the last commit, unless noted otherwise.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: VERDICT command-exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No regeneration was needed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing --filter @objectstack/platform-objects --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0, all four packages done.
- **Reverse verification** (cross-package type change). The member's return was mutated to `{ name: number; … }` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, and spec was rebuilt. `tsc --noEmit` then went red in both consumers:
  - `runtime src/domains/catalog-activation.ts(159,36): error TS2322`
  - `plugin-sharing src/sharing-rule-service.ts(1050,9): error TS2416 Property 'declaredRuleNamed' in type 'SharingRuleService' is not assignable to the same property in base type 'ISharingRuleService'`

  The restore was checked three ways: the blob equals HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`; after a spec rebuild, 0 dist files carry the mutated type; and both consumers' `tsc` passed again.
- **Tests:**
  - `vitest run src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts` (runtime): 64/64.
  - `vitest run src/sharing-rule.test.ts` (plugin-sharing): 140/140.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 87 files, 1278/1278.
- **Runtime publish measure.** After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build`, a grep of `dist/` (maps excluded) for `DeclaredSharingRuleReader`, `ISharingRuleService` and the new comment text finds 0 files each. The positive control `declaredSharingRuleReaderOf` is found in 2 files.
- **Gates.** The local subset comes from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (106 commands). Results are under "Local gates" below.

## Local gates

All gates were run on head `672daf099`.

- **Derived set.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 106 commands, and all 106 were run. The first pass ended with 103 at exit 0 and 3 at exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, no build output): `spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`. Their prerequisite builds were run (turbo, `--concurrency=2`), and all three then exited 0. `check:i18n` reported "all bundles in sync". `check:skill-examples` reported "262 prose examples type-check".
- **Reconciliation.** `dispatch-gates --ran` reports "106 derived, 106 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- **Local-only gates.** `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exited 0, and so did `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness`.
- **Left to CI.** The repo-wide farm (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Build Docs`) is not repeated locally.

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/adr/0126-packaged-metadata-customization-model.md:205` still lists `metadata_type` as (`'flow'`, `'permission'`, …). It is a governed surface and outside this card, so it is left as is. The docblock this PR changes is the field's runtime description.
- Not covered here, and recorded only as an observation: the `/data` door's 409 for the name guard is asserted by the error class's declared `code`/`status` and by the plugin-sharing tests. This PR adds no end-to-end HTTP pin for it.
- **Deviation from the claim's file surface.** The claim listed three files plus a changeset. The dispatch asked for the runtime door to read the contract type in the same PR when it can, so `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` is touched too. The change is type-only.
